[binaries]
c = '/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/llvm/bin/clang'
cpp = '/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/llvm/bin/clang++'
ar = '/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/llvm/bin/llvm-ar'
strip = '/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/llvm/bin/llvm-strip'
ranlib = '/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/llvm/bin/llvm-ranlib'
pkg-config = 'false'
pkgconfig = 'false'
exe_wrapper = '/tmp/cx-meson-device-run.sh'

[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'aarch64'
cpu = 'aarch64'
endian = 'little'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true
# aarch64 Linux/OHOS uses IEEE binary128 long double; the probe cannot run here.
longdouble_format = 'IEEE_QUAD_LE'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['--target=aarch64-linux-ohos', '--sysroot=/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/sysroot', '-O2', '-fPIC']
cpp_args = ['--target=aarch64-linux-ohos', '--sysroot=/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/sysroot', '-O2', '-fPIC']
c_link_args = ['--target=aarch64-linux-ohos', '--sysroot=/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/sysroot', '-shared',
               '-L/Users/huihui/Documents/鸿蒙pc适配/ChimeraX-HarmonyPC/build/cpython-3.11.18/ohos-aarch64-with-libffi-linked/runtime/lib', '-l:libpython3.11.so.1.0',
               '-Wl,-rpath,$ORIGIN/../../../lib']
cpp_link_args = ['--target=aarch64-linux-ohos', '--sysroot=/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/native/sysroot', '-shared',
                 '-L/Users/huihui/Documents/鸿蒙pc适配/ChimeraX-HarmonyPC/build/cpython-3.11.18/ohos-aarch64-with-libffi-linked/runtime/lib', '-l:libpython3.11.so.1.0',
